name: Francolim-de-natal
description: Série curta de chamados kik-kik-kik ao longe.
prompt: Authentic isolated Natal Spurfowl call, Pternistis natalensis, from southern African bushveld at first light. A short series of characteristic sharp, accelerating, strident kik-kik-kik calls ending in a rougher note, followed by silence. Only this species. No domestic chickens, roosters, other birds, mammals, insects, music or voices.
